name: @botschat/botschat
description: BotsChat channel plugin for OpenClaw — connects your OpenClaw agent to the BotsChat cloud platform

scripts.deploy:extension: cd ~/.openclaw/botsChat/packages/plugin && npm run build && rm -rf '/home/openclaw/.openclaw/extensions/botschat' && cp -r /home/openclaw/.openclaw/botsChat/packages/plugin ~/.openclaw/extensions/botschat && cd /home/openclaw/.openclaw/extensions/botschat && npm install && openclaw gateway restart
